name: Witch Doctor Base: Beast Blood shields grouped allies within 40 yd
contract: Base: Beast Blood 705870: '15% of the direct Physical damage taken by party and raid members within $a1
yds' (EffectRadiusIndex 23 = 40 yd) is dealt over time. The DBC force-casts 547573 at
TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID, so every member casts the stagger shield on itself. The server turns Effect[0]
into a raid area dummy aura (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:416-422) and the aura script then called
Cast(player, target, BeastShield) for each member (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:220-226): 547573 has
TargetA 1 TARGET_UNIT_CASTER on both effects, so the shield landed on the doctor again and a grouped ally
35 yd away read 0 in both final06 runs (lead L-S-1). The fix makes the member cast 547573 on itself with
the doctor as the original caster, so the shield, its absorb and its stagger ticks belong to the doctor's
aura script as on the doctor. Expected 1500 ms after the instant cast: the doctor and a grouped ally 10 yd
away carry the area aura 705870 and the shield 547573 of the doctor; a grouped ally 45 yd away carries
